annotation.title_clean: 中华人民共和国国务院令第814号：国务院关于修改《中华人民共和国外国人入境出境管理条例》的决定（附修订后条例全文）
annotation.title_en: State Council Order No. 814: Decision on Amending the Regulations on the Entry and Exit of Foreigners (with revised full text)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 中华人民共和国国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.summary_en: China State Council Order No. 814 amends the Regulations on Entry and Exit of Foreigners, adding a K visa for young foreign science and technology talent, effective 1 October 2025. It republishes the full regulations on visas, residence permits, investigation and repatriation. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds K visa category for foreign young science and technology talent (Art. 6).
K visa applicants must meet conditions set by competent Chinese authorities and submit supporting documents (Art. 7).
Republished regulations cover visa categories, residence permits, detention and repatriation procedures.
